title: CryptoFlowBench: Benchmarking Multi-Hop Reasoning on Blockchains for Cryptocurrency Fund Tracing
abstract: arXiv:2610.16449v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pseudonymous accounts and complex smart-contract ecosystems substantially hinder the tracing of illicit cryptocurrency fund flows. Existing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved promising performance in blockchain fraud detection, yet their static node- or edge-level predictions do not naturally generalize to multi-hop fund tracing. Meanwhile, existing tracing methods mainly rely on predefined heuristics to capture multi-hop relationships, limiting their adaptive reasoning capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce CryptoFlowBench, a benchmark constructed from authoritative reports on cryptocurrency-related illicit incidents, with four tasks spanning local to multi-hop fund tracing. These tasks pose substantial challenges to existing learning- and heuristic-based methods, particularly in complex multi-hop scenarios. translated_title: CryptoFlowBench：面向加密货币资金追踪的区块链多跳推理基准测试
translated_abstract: 化名账户和复杂的智能合约生态系统极大地阻碍了对非法加密货币资金流动的追踪。现有的图神经网络（GNN）在区块链欺诈检测方面已取得令人瞩目的性能，但其静态的节点级或边级预测无法自然地泛化到多跳资金追踪任务。与此同时，现有的追踪方法主要依赖预定义的启发式规则来捕捉多跳关系，限制了其自适应推理能力。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了CryptoFlowBench，这是一个基于加密货币相关非法事件权威报告构建的基准测试，包含从局部到多跳资金追踪的四个任务。这些任务对现有的基于学习和启发式的方法构成了重大挑战，尤其是在复杂的多跳场景中。因此，我们提出了ChainSleuth，一个图工具增强的智能体，它能够迭代地进行推理、调用图工具……
tldr: 该论文提出了基于真实非法事件构建的区块链多跳资金追踪基准CryptoFlowBench，并设计了图工具增强智能体ChainSleuth，通过迭代推理与图工具调用实现自适应的多跳非法资金追踪。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CryptoFlowBench, a benchmark with four tasks for multi-hop cryptocurrency fund tracing built from authoritative illicit incident reports, and proposes ChainSleuth, a graph-tool-augmented agent that adaptively performs multi-hop reasoning to trace illicit fund flows.
